english: 44-47. At that time the king was commanded by the Lord, of Devas himself: “Guard these two excellent trees of Tintiṇī (Tamarind) and Caṃpaka. The Tamarind tree is my abode while the Caṃpaka is the abode of Lakṣmī. They are always to be bowed to by kings, sages, Devas and human beings. After retaining these two, O excellent king, cut off all the other big trees. Build the rampart wall alone for me with an ornamented gateway and doors. A king of your lineage, Nārāyaṇa by name, a great devotee of mine, will make the Vimāna (Temple). He will adorn it with gold.”
